sourceRationale: PS3 trophy list chosen per instructions because it carries native tiers (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum), which Port Mode Rule 22 preserves directly. Multiple independent sources (PSNProfiles, TrueTrophies, PlayStationTrophies.org, PlayStationLifestyle.net) agree the PS3 list totals 51 trophies (1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 10 Silver, 38 Bronze). Primary trophy-database sites (PSNProfiles, TrueTrophies, GameFAQs, StrategyWiki, PlayStationTrophies.org, Fandom wiki) all returned HTTP 403/402 errors to direct fetch (Cloudflare/paywall blocks), so the full name+description+tier table was reconstructed from a successfully-fetched PlayStationLifestyle.net trophy list article, corroborated and spot-checked against WebSearch result snippets sourced from TrueTrophies/TrueAchievements/PlayStationTrophies.org. The Xbox 360 achievement list (50 achievements, 1000G, no Platinum) shares the same 50 base names as the PS3 Bronze/Silver/Gold set plus the PS3-exclusive Platinum trophy 'Acquire all Trophies' = 51.

Whether 'Taste Of The Witching Hour' is a real, separate Bronze trophy distinct from 'Umbra Witch' — plausible and numerically consistent (38 bronze total matches 51-1-2-10) but not independently corroborated on a second live site.

The full block of 10 chapter-range trophies ('Chapters X-Y (Normal)' and 'New Testament: Ch. X-Y (Hard)' / 'New Testament: Close The Book') — confirmed that 'Chapters 1-4 (Normal)' exists as a real Xbox 360 achievement (20G) via TrueAchievements; assumed the PS3 trophy list mirrors the same 50-item base achievement set plus the exclusive Platinum trophy, which is a common (but not 100% verified here) cross-platform pattern for this game.
Secret/hidden trophy flags — one source snippet claimed '15 secret trophies' but could not retrieve which specific ones are marked secret.

Exact wording of a handful of Bronze descriptions (e.g. 'Come Here, Little Boy', 'The Deepest Cut') pulled from a single source fetch, not cross-referenced word-for-word against a second independent source.
